message.content: {"evidence":"The temporary-offset hypothesis restores continuity across J2–J4 in all three axes, while the permanent-step hypothesis leaves a residual offset after J4 and the isolated-point hypothesis fails to correct the sustained shift between J2 and J4; interior observations (655–666) consistently follow a shifted trajectory relative to both pre-J2 and post-J4 segments.","pair_ids":["P5"]}
